summary: After the cgroup setup, existing Podman processes may need stopping so Podman sees the new mount; look for podman and catatonit processes.
questions: Podman still fails after I mounted the systemd cgroup, why?
How do I tell if Podman processes are still running?

answer_card.title: Restart Podman after cgroup changes
answer_card.answer_md: Running Podman processes may not see the new cgroup mount. Look for `podman` and `catatonit` processes and stop them, then retry.
